sdss.layout: uint64 SDSS id; float32 RA hours, Dec degrees, distance Mpc/h; uint8 WWT morphology bucket; float32 WWT display size. Little endian.
sdss.credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey / WorldWide Telescope. Catalogue served by WWT; original survey selection retained.

twoMrs.selection: cz > 600 km/s; no invented distance for missing or negative redshift. No peculiar-velocity correction. Named nearby galaxies are separate reference objects.
twoMrs.credit: Huchra et al. 2012, ApJS 199,26 / CDS VizieR J/ApJS/199/26

flows.credit: Courtois et al. 2023 A&A 670 L15; Dupuy & Courtois 2023 A&A 678 A176 / Cosmicflows-4
flows.grid: Ungrouped CF4, 64^3 velocity grid over 1000 Mpc/h; basin 1 from 128^3 watershed grid. XYZ velocity components, ZYX array axes.
flows.integration: RK2 normalized vector field; 2 Mpc/h step; up to 110 steps; gold seed inside Laniakea basin, blue outside. Curves are not galaxy trajectories or density filaments.
flows.uncertainty: Reconstructed, smoothed present-day peculiar velocity field; boundary is the 2023 watershed solution, not an exact material surface.
